answer: Cap reciprocity: each agent gets 10 attestations per epoch, and any pair that attests each other more than 3 times in 5 epochs is flagged. Flagged clusters collapse into one island whose attestations count once in total, so a 100-sybil ring earns 1/100 of what 100 independent agents earn. Weakness: rings rotate partners to dodge pair counts. Fix: every agent posts a 50-token anchor bond, and 5 random established graders run an opal-clear audit of the ring's last 10 epochs that then slashes every bond inside an island it confirms.
